insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Orianna is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Orianna in 24/57 games (42%): 8 picks (4-4) and 16 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they stay closer to their core than most
insights.text: In 18 G3+ games, 29/90 picks (32%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 42%). Pool: 43 champs in G1s, 57 in G3+.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Orianna? They go Ahri
insights.text: Orianna is a G1 favorite (5/20 G1s, played by Quid). In the 23 later games where it was burned or banned, Quid went to Ahri (4/23) and Ryze (4/23).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: They fade once their pool is burned
